developer.intro: I build practical tools and interfaces. My work includes a native Fire TV launcher and a daily news digest.
developer.about: I’m interested in software that makes everyday tasks a little easier. These projects bring together interface work, device customization, and automation.

projects.name: AFT Home
projects.summary: A lightweight Android TV launcher for Fire TV, with a clear app layout and navigation designed for a remote.
projects.imageAlt: AFT Home running on Fire TV, showing a clock and a horizontal row of app cards over a mountain background.

notes.label: Interface
notes.text: Installed apps are discovered and ordered into a horizontal row. D-pad navigation remembers the last focused app.

notes.label: Device behavior
notes.text: A launcher chooser, Wi-Fi shortcut, and low-motion screensaver are documented alongside the Fire OS setup and recovery steps.

notes.label: Work proof
notes.text: The repository includes the native Java implementation, build instructions, and screenshots captured on Fire TV.

projects.name: Newsbot
projects.summary: A personal AI and technology news digest that collects RSS headlines and links, then delivers them to Telegram.

notes.label: Workflow
notes.text: Configured RSS feeds are fetched, filtered by a lookback window, and formatted into a headlines-and-links digest.

notes.label: Running it
notes.text: The command line supports feed checks and dry runs. GitHub Actions can run the digest on a daily schedule.

notes.label: Work proof
notes.text: The public source separates feed handling, configuration, digest formatting, and Telegram delivery, with offline tests documented in the README.

editor.intro: Video editing, with attention to the story behind each cut.
editor.about: This portfolio is being put together around two edits. Each will include the finished video and a short breakdown of the editing decisions.
